headline: Umar Khalid, accused in 2020 Delhi riots conspiracy case under UAPA, back in news
caption:

headline: Jailed Delhi riots UAPA accused Umar Khalid reportedly gets human rights award
caption:
Delhi dange ke UAPA aaropi ko human rights award? Ye kya scene hai 😳
Umar Khalid jail mein hai, UAPA ke tahat kathit taur par aaropi, aur uska trial abhi jaari hai.
Ab unhe human rights award milne ki khabar aayi hai.
Sawal ye hai: jis case mein dange ke aarop lage hain, usi naam ko "human rights" ka taj kyun?
Aaropi ko award: sahi to ✅, galat to 🤡
